title: Philippine peso sinks to record low P64.17 vs $1 | The wRap
summary: Today’s headlines: Philippine economy, BARMM, Manny Villar

blocks.text: Here are today’s headlines – the latest news in the Philippines and around the world:

items: Philippine peso’s historic slide continues, hitting record low P64.17 per dollar

blocks.text: The Philippine peso falls to a record low of P64.17 against the US dollar, despite aggressive interest rate hikes by the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas.

items: BARMM’s Teduray, Lambangian tribes win ancestral land after 2 decades of struggle

blocks.text: The Teduray and Lambangian indigenous communities in the Bangsamoro region achieve formal recognition of 117,101 hectares of ancestral land.

items: Villar’s Vista Land 2025 net income falls 59% as delayed figures surface

blocks.text: Billionaire Manny Villar’s Vista Land and Lifescapes reports a 59% drop in net income for 2025, a steep drop amid soaring financing costs and provisions for potentially uncollectible receivables.

items: Netanyahu’s political survival on the line as Israel votes

blocks.text: Israel Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu faces a fight for political survival in the country’s election on Tuesday, October 27.

items: Filipino-Canadian voice actor Eric Bauza dies at 46

blocks.text: Filipino-Canadian voice actor Eric Bauza passed away on October 25 at the age of 46. – Rappler.com
